user_input: Which mitigation options have direct, active mitigates relationships in Enterprise ATT&CK 17.1 to the technique mapped to Ligolo in AA23-165A? Start from LockBit affiliates and follow the three-hop actor-to-software-to-technique-to-mitigation path. Distinguish advisory observations from reference recommendations.
response:
LockBit affiliates' activity may be mitigated by Pre-compromise (M1056) as per ATT&CK 17.1. [E2, E4, E8]
LockBit affiliates' activity may be mitigated by Execution Prevention (M1038) as per ATT&CK 17.1. [E6]
LockBit affiliates' activity may be mitigated by Disable or Remove Feature or Program (M1042) as per ATT&CK 17.1. [E10]
